svg.title: Tree3D inspector and preview (G8b)
svg.desc: Planned editor view of a selected Tree3D: on the right the inspector with a custom header (preset dropdown set to Oak Medium, an import button, seed 35729 with a dice button, a Realistic/LowPoly style toggle), the Branches group with Level 0 expanded into sliders and Levels 1 to 3 collapsed, the Leaves group, the collapsed Bark group, a LOD table with triangle and vertex counts for LOD0, LOD1, LOD2 and the impostor, and icon buttons for Bake, Bake variants and Create collider with a tooltip. On the left the viewport shows the generated oak with its LOD0 statistics, the wind preview toggle, and two distant trees drawn at LOD2 and as an impostor.
svg.text: Tree3D · Oak Medium · seed 35729 · Scale 0.3 (≈ 20 m)
Header: preset, seed and style. One foldout per TreeLevel; the viewport regenerates live. Counts: Oak Medium, Realistic.
